description: Set up Proxylang on a website with no signup: returns the script tag, install steps for the site's platform, an agent_token for the other tools, and claim_url (sent once; save it). If the user named a language, use it; otherwise pick the one their customers most likely speak and say why. The free trial shows the first language; list other recommended languages after it.

languages.description: Language codes, most important first, e.g. ["ja", "ko"].

source_lang.description: Optional. The site's own language; read from the page when left out.

name: proxylang_start
title: Start a Proxylang trial
